title: Session timeline · ET-SoC-1
description: The ET-SoC-1 work on the AI Foundry lab's machine from 19 September 2026 (PDT) to 5 October on one zoomable, swipeable time axis: the owner's messages with their own words, the main agent and its subagents, every other session on the machine in a lane of its own, the four cards and the hosts and cards down, and every deploy and commit, with the totals of human, agent and card time and the tokens used.
